oneOf.description: No noise: the browser's own audio.
Deterministic noise from the fingerprint's seed.
Noise from a fresh seed each time the script is generated.

charging_time.description: Seconds until fully charged (`f64::INFINITY` when unknown; `null` in JSON).

discharging_time.description: Seconds until empty (`f64::INFINITY` when charging; `null` in JSON).

BrandVersion.description: A `(brand, version)` pair used by the Client Hints `brands` array.

BrowserType.description: Browser persona requested by a profile.

oneOf.description: Firefox-oriented persona (conceptual; WebDriver mode uses Chromium).
No noise: the browser's own canvas.
Deterministic noise from the fingerprint's seed, the same on every read and every launch.
Noise from a fresh seed each time the script is generated, so each browser context gets different noise.
Seeded noise on about one pixel in eight.

form_factors.description: Client Hints form factors, such as `Desktop` or `Mobile` (`Sec-CH-UA-Form-Factors`).

wow64.description: Whether the browser runs as a 32-bit process on a 64-bit system (`Sec-CH-UA-WoW64`).

oneOf.description: `srgb`: the gamut of an ordinary desktop display.
`p3`: a Retina Mac or a recent phone.

ColorScheme.description: The colour scheme a page's `prefers-color-scheme` media query reports.

oneOf.description: No override: the browser's own setting decides again.

Fields.description: The data of a `Fingerprint`: one field per setting.

audio_sample_rate.description: Web Audio sample rate in Hz (`audio_sample_rate`).

battery.description: The Battery Status API. `off` makes it unavailable.

bluetooth.description: Web Bluetooth: `true` has an adapter, `false` has none, `off` makes the API unavailable.

browser_type.description: The browser the identity claims to be. `chromium` by default.

client_hints.description: User-Agent Client Hints (`navigator.userAgentData`). `off` makes them unavailable.

connection.description: The Network Information API. `off` makes it unavailable.

core_version.description: The Chromium major version the identity claims, such as 155.

custom_start_urls.description: The URLs the profile opens at start.

geolocation.description: The position `navigator.geolocation` reports. `off` denies the request.

local_storage.description: Whether `localStorage` is kept between sessions of the profile.

media_features.description: The display's colour gamut and the user's preferences, as `matchMedia` and `@media` report them.

os_type.description: The operating system the identity claims. Taken from the user agent when the file does not say, and Windows when that names none.

policy.description: How the claims are delivered and which protections run beside them.

proxy.description: The proxy the browser is launched with. May hold a login.

save_service_worker.description: Whether service workers are kept between sessions of the profile.

seed.description: The seed of the random draws and of the canvas and audio noise.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone, such as `Europe/Berlin`.

webgl.description: The unmasked WebGL vendor and renderer.

webrtc.description: The addresses WebRTC reports. `off` makes WebRTC unavailable.

accuracy.description: How far off the position may be, in metres; `100` when absent.

altitude.description: Metres above sea level; `0` when absent.

HoverType.description: Whether the primary pointing system allows hovering over elements (`hover: hover` vs `none`).

mouse_steps.description: Number of intermediate points sampled along a mouse path.

KeyboardLayout.description: The layout `navigator.keyboard.getLayoutMap()` reports: the character each writing-system key types, unshifted. The maps are Windows's own layouts (KBDUS, KBDGR, KBDFR); a Mac's punctuation keys differ a little.

oneOf.description: The US layout, used for English and most of the world.
The German layout, used in central Europe.

MediaDeviceSpec.description: A single labeled media device used by `MediaDevicesProvider`.

labelled.description: Devices with their own ids and labels. When this is not empty, it is the whole list and the counts are not used.

MediaFeatures.description: What `matchMedia` and `@media` rules report about the display and the user's preferences. The pointer and hover features belong to the device: a phone persona's touch emulation gives them.

color_gamut.description: `color-gamut`: the widest gamut the display covers.

dynamic_range.description: `dynamic-range`: whether the display covers High Dynamic Range.

PointerType.description: The primary pointing system accuracy (`pointer: fine` vs `coarse` vs `none`).

ScreenSize.description: A screen size in CSS pixels.

SpeechVoice.description: A single synthesized speech voice for `speechSynthesis.getVoices()`.

StealthPolicy.description: How a fingerprint's claims are delivered and which protections run with them. See the module documentation.

block_trackers.description: Block the tracker and fingerprinting-script hosts.

blocked_ports.description: Ports the browser may not reach on the loopback names.

blocked_trackers.description: The hosts to block when `block_trackers` is on. Empty means the crate's default list.

chrome_runtime.description: Install the `window.chrome` runtime, app, `csi` and `loadTimes` stubs.

disable_csp.description: Bypass Content-Security-Policy for the page context.

grant_permissions.description: Grant common browser permissions at start so permission prompts, a bot-detection signal, do not fire.

headless_fixes.description: Apply the headless fixes: permissions consistency, page visibility and the hairline media query.

native_spoofing.description: Apply spoofing through CDP and launch arguments instead of JavaScript where possible. The browser's own implementation then answers with the fake value, so the spoof is invisible to `toString` and `getOwnPropertyNames`.

native_tostring.description: Mask `Function.prototype.toString` so patched natives look native. On by default, because the other evasions rely on it.

open_shadow_roots.description: Force every closed shadow root open, so automation can reach into it. A page can detect this, so turn it off where that matters. On by default.

webrtc_policy.description: The WebRTC IP-handling policy the browser is launched with. `None` passes no policy flag unless the fingerprint sets WebRTC, which uses `WebRtcPolicy::DisableNonProxiedUdp`.

WebGl.description: The WebGL strings `getParameter` reports for the unmasked vendor and renderer.

max_texture_size.description: Maximum texture size (e.g. 16384 for desktop, 8192/4096 for mobile).

renderer_id.description: The PCI device id of the GPU (`0x1f91`). Kept, never shown to a page.

vendor_id.description: The PCI vendor id of the GPU (`0x10de`). It is kept for tools that read it and never shown to a page.

WebRtcAddresses.description: The addresses WebRTC reports, and with them the request that its STUN and TURN servers are filtered.

local_ip.description: The local address of the connection line.

public_ip.description: The public address of the candidates.

description: What a browser claims to be, as seleniumbase-rs reads it: one entry per setting, each "natural" (left out), "random", "off" or a value. A setting that is left out is the browser's own.
